concerns.text: FR-001 (dataset ingestion & filtering) has no explicitly linked task. No task is tagged `[FR-001]` nor does any task description unambiguously state it implements the required filtering heuristic and curated CSV output.

FR-002 (CPU‑based geometric solver using solvePnP) is not covered by any task tag or description. Tasks T015‑T022 mention line detection and solver scaffolding, but none are explicitly marked as implementing `cv2.solvePnP` with the canonical unit‑grid model.
The plan specifies generation of `dataset.schema.yaml` and `output.schema.yaml` contracts, but the task list contains no item that creates or validates these contract files.
